info.title: SHAPI advisory twilio-conference-list-default-in-progress
info.summary: Twilio Conference list returns only in-progress conferences by default from 2026-09-30

workflows.summary: Shows the change: Starting September 30, 2026 (rollout delayed from July 13, 2026), GET /2010-04-01/Accounts/{AccountSid}/Conferences.json without a Status filter returns only in-progress conferences instead of in-progress and completed ones. Code that lists conferences without Status and expects completed ones gets silently incomplete results.

steps.description: GET /2010-04-01/Accounts/{AccountSid}/Conferences.json succeeds, with the changed response the advisory describes (required-field)
